title: Learn hub: replace /templates with a unified learning catalog
description:
Problem: /templates (branch pse/adds-templates) was a bespoke blueprint-styled page, and the content strategy was too narrow.

Vision (expanded 2026-08-22): /learn is an IBM-Think-style editorial hub (reference: https://www.ibm.com/think) that unifies our learning and editorial content: templates, videos, tutorials, examples, workshops, blog articles, and upcoming comparisons/explainers. Phase 1 (tasks .1-.7): faceted catalog replacing /templates, shared design language, redirects, seeds. Phase 2 (tasks .8-.12): content strategy and IA (Fable 5), editorial design addendum (Fable 5), editorial landing at /learn with the catalog demoted to a browse surface, blog integration (model gated on a user ruling), and a comparison/explainer article pipeline.

Ordering: .8 -> .9 -> .10 -> .11; .12 after .8 and .9. Blog work (.11) additionally requires a recorded user ruling.

comments.author: planner-1
comments.text: User rulings (2026-08-22): 1) URL structure: new /learn hub; /templates redirects into it; detail pages under /learn/templates/[slug]. 2) The design-direction task (website-5yo.1) must be run by the orchestrator on a Fable 5 agent (claude-fable-5). 3) Drop the blueprint aesthetic entirely; the new design must match the existing content pages. 4) Content strategy is broader than templates: templates, videos, tutorials, examples, workshops, with more types expected later, so the content model must be extensible.

comments.author: planner-1
comments.text: User ruling addendum (2026-08-22, second briefing): /learn must become an IBM-Think-style editorial hub, not only a faceted catalog. The catalog/search view stays but as one surface. The blog must become part of the hub experience; HOW (keep URLs vs migrate, traditional blog vs editorial stream) is intentionally undecided and must be figured out in the website-5yo.8 review of the IBM model, then put to the user for a ruling before website-5yo.11 starts. Lots of editorial content (comparisons etc.) is planned and needs a home.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: NEEDS-PASCAL (deferred, cosmetic): LearnCard renders the trailing CTA in the per-type accent color (meta.text) while learn-hub.md section 4 says text-cc-accent with accent confined to badge and hover border; the spec is self-contradictory. Chose: kept per-type tint as implemented. Say the word and .7 or a follow-up flips it to cc-accent.

title: Design direction for /learn hub (Fable 5 design agent)
description:
Problem: the current /templates design (blueprint backdrop, bespoke hero and catalog styling in src/components/templates/) does not fit the rest of the site. Before any implementation, we need an approved design direction for the /learn hub.

Agent requirement: the orchestrator MUST run this task on a Fable 5 agent (model claude-fable-5). This is a design-quality gate, not an implementation task.

File scope: read-only over app/(content)/, src/components/, src/design-system/, app/globals.css. Deliverable is a design spec written to website/docs/design/learn-hub.md (create the directory if missing). No component or page code changes.

Fix direction: study the existing content pages (/resources, /pricing, /products, /platform) on the running dev server and the shared primitives (PageHero, Section, CardGrid, LinkCard, text-hero/text-h1..h6 scale, font-heading/font-body). Produce a spec covering: hub page layout (hero, facet/filter bar, card grid), a unified content card that works for all content types (template, video, tutorial, example, workshop) with per-type accents, detail page layout for templates, empty/loading states, and light/dark behavior. Explicitly state what replaces the blueprint aesthetic. Include which existing primitives are reused vs which new components are needed (with proposed names under src/components/learn/).

Verification: spec file exists, names concrete components and utilities that exist in the repo, and covers all five content types plus the template detail page. Dev server for visual reference: yarn next dev on a free port (3001/3002 are held by dcp, do not kill it).

Non-goals: writing any page/component code, changing globals.css, changing the templates data.
closeReason: Design spec landed in commit 451b2a05d6 (website/docs/design/learn-hub.md, single-file pathspec commit). Ran on a Fable 5 agent per user ruling. Opus review: pass, 2 minor findings (recorded on website-5yo.3 for the implementer). Spec covers all 5 content types, template detail layout, empty/loading states, single-dark-theme token rules, and reused-vs-proposed component inventory.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Design spec committed at website/docs/design/learn-hub.md (commit 451b2a05d6). Direction: drop BlueprintBackdrop entirely, page sits on the global surface; PageHero (content-page hero, not MarketingHero) + horizontal facet bar (content-type pills primary, product filter shared, template-only axes in a disclosure when Templates active) + CardGrid cols=3 progressive. Unified LearnCard for all 5 types with per-type accent chips mapped to existing tokens (template=cc-accent, video=cc-danger, tutorial=cc-success, example=cc-info, workshop=cc-warning) via a STATUS_META-style static class map. Template detail keeps the existing TemplateDetail structure, moved under src/components/learn/. Spec is aligned with the existing src/data/learn/types.ts + facets.ts model.

title: /learn editorial landing: implement hub front, relocate faceted catalog to browse surface
description:
Problem: website-5yo.3 ships the faceted catalog at /learn, but per the expanded vision /learn itself must be an IBM-Think-style editorial landing; the catalog becomes the browse surface at the route the strategy doc picks (for example /learn/browse).

File scope: app/(content)/learn/ (landing page plus the browse route), src/components/learn/. Read-only: the strategy doc (website-5yo.8), design addendum (website-5yo.9), src/data/learn, and the blog data helpers used by the current /blog pages for the latest-posts rail.

Fix direction: implement the landing per the design addendum: featured story hero, latest rail (may include blog posts via a read-only adapter over the existing blog data, no blog URL changes in this task), topic rails from the taxonomy, curated collection, explainers/comparisons section placeholder-free (only render sections that have content), video section, newsletter CTA, and a clear entry to the browse surface. Move the catalog page from website-5yo.3 to its browse route, preserving its URL-synced filters; update internal links landed by website-5yo.4 and website-5yo.5 if they point at /learn as catalog. Re-verify what website-5yo.5 landed for redirects: /templates should now land on the browse surface or the landing per the strategy doc.

Verification: /learn shows the editorial landing, the browse route serves the catalog with filters working, /learn/templates/<slug> still renders, light and dark checked on the dev server (free port, do not kill dcp on 3001/3002); npx eslint on changed files; yarn format then yarn format:check.

Non-goals: blog restyling or URL migration (website-5yo.11), comparison authoring pipeline (website-5yo.12), new content.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Binding notes from the .9 design review: 1) learn-editorial.md 3.8 stacks LearnSubscribeBand directly above NextStepsSection, which are visually identical band+heading+buttons units; COLLAPSE into a single closing band (subscribe actions + browse/docs links in one ButtonRow, or two clearly differentiated skins - pick one, record choice as a comment). 2) The landing order in learn-editorial.md (featured hero 3.2 before Latest 3.3) is the deliberate, binding order; ignore the inverted order in learn-content-strategy.md 4.1. 3) User ruling landed AFTER the .9 doc was written: blog model is Option C (migrate posts into /learn, see comment on website-5yo.11). The ArticleLayout in learn-editorial.md was designed ruling-neutral and still applies; do not build any /blog restyling into .10.

title: Blog integration into the /learn hub (model per user ruling)
description:
GATE: do NOT start until a user ruling on the blog model (from the website-5yo.8 options) is recorded as a comment on THIS task. The orchestrator surfaces the recommendation to the user and records the answer.

Problem: the current /blog is visually not up to standard and disconnected from the hub. Per the ruling it either stays at /blog restyled and surfaced in /learn rails, or posts migrate into the hub IBM-style.

File scope depends on the ruling; the superset is app/blog/, content/blog/ (frontmatter only, no content rewriting), src/components/Blog*.tsx and FromOurBlog.tsx, src/components/learn/, plus next.config redirects and app/sitemap.ts if URLs move. RSS at /blog/rss.xml must keep working (301 to a new feed URL is acceptable only if the ruling moves URLs).

Fix direction: restyle blog index and post pages to the article design from website-5yo.9; tag posts with hub topics so they appear in topic rails; if the ruling migrates URLs, add permanent redirects for all 27 posts and the tag pages, and keep RSS valid.

Verification: blog index and at least 3 representative posts (oldest, newest, one with images) render correctly in light and dark; RSS still parses (curl and check XML); if URLs moved, curl old post URLs and assert 301/308 to new ones; npx eslint and yarn format:check on changed files.

Non-goals: rewriting post content, changing authors pages beyond styling, comparison content.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: GATE: do not start until the user's blog-model ruling is recorded here. Options per docs/design/learn-content-strategy.md section 5: A) keep /blog as-is, surface in hub rails; B) restyle /blog in place as the hub's article archive, keep all URLs and RSS (RECOMMENDED); C) migrate posts to /learn/articles with redirects and RSS churn. Surfaced to the user by the orchestrator on 2026-08-23.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: USER RULING (2026-08-23, confirmed): Option C - migrate all blog posts into the hub IBM-style. Move posts to the /learn article namespace per docs/design/learn-content-strategy.md section 5 Option C, permanent redirects from every /blog/* URL (posts, index, tag pages, pagination), and resolve the RSS feed handling (redirect /blog/rss.xml or keep emitting with new item URLs - implementer proposes, orchestrator reviews). User confirmed despite the documented redirect/RSS churn costs. The gate on this task is now LIFTED; it remains dep-blocked by .9 and .10.

title: Comparison and explainer article pipeline plus first seed article
description:
Problem: planned content (comparisons like ChilliCream versus other GraphQL stacks, what-is explainers) has no home, no authoring format, and no rendering template.

File scope: content/ (new directory per the strategy doc, for example content/learn/), the article route under app/(content)/learn/ that the strategy doc assigns, src/components/learn/. Follow the authoring conventions in website/README.md (Authoring Markdown Content) rather than inventing a new pipeline; reuse the blog markdown machinery where possible.

Fix direction: define frontmatter for articles (type: comparison or explainer, topics, products, updated date), wire rendering through the article page design from website-5yo.9 including the comparison layout, and ship ONE real seed article (a comparison or explainer grounded in facts from our docs; no invented benchmark numbers) to prove the pipeline end to end. Surface it in the landing explainers section and the browse facets.

Verification: the seed article renders at its route in light and dark, appears on the /learn landing and in browse filters, structured data (Article) present; npx eslint and yarn format:check on changed files.

Non-goals: bulk content authoring, blog migration, newsletter infrastructure.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Binding note from the .9 design review: learn-editorial.md 6.1 extends CONTENT_TYPE_META with article/comparison/explainer chips but only specifies text/bg/ring. The ContentTypeMeta interface also requires label, ctaLabel, hoverBorder, activePill, and the record is keyed by LearnContentType (src/data/learn/facets.ts), so adding types makes them appear in the facet bar. Implementer decides the missing fields and whether the new types are facetable in /learn/browse, and records the decision as a task comment. Also note: blog model ruling is Option C (see website-5yo.11 comment); article URLs live under the /learn namespace.

title: Learn content model: generalize templates data into src/data/learn
description:
Problem: src/data/templates/templates.ts and filters.ts model only templates (6 template-specific filter axes). The hub must carry templates, videos, tutorials, examples, and workshops.

File scope: src/data/learn/ (new), src/data/templates/ (may re-export or move). Do not touch components or routes; the existing /templates pages must keep compiling (keep the current exports working until the routes task lands).

Fix direction: introduce a LearnItem discriminated union keyed on type: template | video | tutorial | example | workshop. Shared fields: slug, title, tagline, products, level or useCases, updated info, optional external URL. Type-specific payloads: templates keep their current shape (topology, language, clients, stack, agentReady, cli, body); video gets url and duration; tutorial/example/workshop get minimal shapes for now. Migrate the 8 existing templates into the new model (mechanical move, do not rewrite content). Provide shared facet definitions: content type is the primary facet; keep template-only axes scoped to templates. Export summaries for the hub grid.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit passes (or yarn build type check), npx eslint on changed files passes, existing /templates pages still render on the dev server.

Non-goals: authoring new non-template content (separate seed task), UI changes, deleting src/data/templates before the routes are migrated.
closeReason: Landed in commit b47b6d30d1: src/data/learn/ with LearnItem union (template|video|tutorial|example|workshop), 8 templates migrated mechanically, src/data/templates/* now re-export shims so /templates keeps working (smoke-tested live). Gates: tsc --noEmit (only pre-existing unrelated errors), eslint clean, prettier check pass. Opus review: pass with minor findings only. Interpretive decision (level vs useCases) recorded as comment on the task.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: NEEDS-PASCAL: spec says shared fields include 'level or useCases' - ambiguous whether that's one field that varies per type, or two separate concepts | chose: useCases stays a template-only field (matches 'keep template-only axes scoped to templates'); added an optional level?: LearnLevel field (beginner/intermediate/advanced) on VideoItem/TutorialItem/ExampleItem/WorkshopItem for the non-template content types. Not shared on the LearnItem base.

title: /learn hub page: unified catalog with content-type facets
description:
Problem: there is no unified learning catalog page; /templates is a template-only page in a blueprint style that clashes with the site.

File scope: app/(content)/learn/page.tsx (new), src/components/learn/ (new components per the approved spec). Read-only use of src/data/learn from website-5yo.2 and the design spec at website/docs/design/learn-hub.md from website-5yo.1.

Fix direction: implement the hub exactly per the approved design spec: PageHero-consistent hero, content-type facet as the primary filter, unified LearnCard rendering all five types with per-type accents, template-only filter axes appearing only when the template facet is active. Preserve the useful behavior of TemplateCatalog (URL-synced filters if the spec keeps them). Include structured data (BreadcrumbList plus ItemList) and pageMetadata like the current templates page.

Verification: visual check of /learn on the dev server (yarn next dev on a free port, 3001/3002 are held by dcp, do not kill it) in light and dark; npx eslint on changed files; yarn format then yarn format:check.

Non-goals: detail pages (website-5yo.4), redirects and nav (website-5yo.5), deleting old template components (website-5yo.7), authoring content.
closeReason: Hub landed: commits a6d7f41443 + fix 0fbe0acbdd. Opus review pass after 1 fix cycle (pill counts, stale axis params on type switch; verified live via Playwright on port 3215). Gates: tsc/eslint/prettier clean. Remaining minor: latent learnItemHref '#' fallback (unreachable with current data), CTA tint per content type deviates from spec's text-cc-accent (deferred to user, see epic note).

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Review notes from website-5yo.1 spec review (binding for implementation): 1) contentTypeLabel in src/data/learn/facets.ts returns PLURAL labels (Templates, Videos...). ContentTypeBadge needs singular labels; put a singular label field in the proposed CONTENT_TYPE_META record in src/components/learn/contentTypeMeta.ts instead of reusing contentTypeLabel. 2) Spec says default ordering is 'templates with featured first', but TemplateSummary (Pick in src/data/learn/types.ts) omits 'featured'. Resolve by either sorting on full LearnItems before summarizing, or widening the Pick to include featured. Record which you chose as a task comment.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Resolved featured-ordering vs TemplateSummary Pick (review note #1): did NOT widen the Pick or touch src/data/learn. Instead, app/(content)/learn/page.tsx reads the featured flag off the full LEARN_ITEMS (which still carries it on TemplateItem), builds a Set of featured template slugs, and sorts LEARN_SUMMARIES by that lookup (featured first, then CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS order, then title) before passing the ordered array into LearnCatalog. Zero changes to src/data/learn.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Also recorded: (1) ContentTypeBadge uses singular labels from a new CONTENT_TYPE_META record in src/components/learn/contentTypeMeta.ts (per review note #1), not facets.contentTypeLabel (plural). (2) File scope forbids touching src/components/templates/, so TemplateStackArt/STACK_ICONS/PRODUCT_ART could not literally 'move' there per the spec's component inventory; instead I created new src/components/learn/stackIcons.ts and productArt.ts (productArt trimmed to just Drink+drinkName, since the glow/ART_DOT_GRID/accentProduct fields are only used by TemplateStackArt on the detail page, which is website-5yo.4's scope) retargeted at src/data/learn types. The old src/components/templates/* copies are untouched; retiring them is website-5yo.7. (3) Verified /learn visually on a scratch copy of the repo (dev server on the shared working tree collides with the other running session regardless of port, via Next's per-project .next/dev/lock) at port 3201: hero, all 5 content-type cards with correct accents/CTAs/external-link affordance, product+stack icon footer, content-type pill counts, product pills, the Templates-only 'More filters' disclosure (topology/use/language/client/agent-ready, product excluded since it has its own always-visible row), URL sync, debounced search, the 'Nothing matches' empty state, and Clear all reset. (4) The site is single-theme dark (no light-mode toggle exists), so I did not do a separate light-mode pass despite the ticket text mentioning light/dark; confirmed by the design spec section 7 which states there is no data-theme/prefers-color-scheme handling on this site.

title: /learn/templates/[slug] detail pages per the new design
description:
Problem: template detail pages live at /templates/[slug] with the blueprint-era TemplateDetail styling; they must move under the hub and adopt the approved design.

File scope: app/(content)/learn/templates/[slug]/page.tsx (new), src/components/learn/ for the restyled detail components. Reuse the route logic from app/(content)/templates/[slug]/page.tsx (generateStaticParams, generateMetadata, SoftwareSourceCode structured data) with paths updated to /learn/templates.

Fix direction: port TemplateDetail to the design spec at website/docs/design/learn-hub.md: consistent typography and section primitives, keep the deploy sidebar content (cli commands, github link, license, stack) but styled like the rest of the site. Related items rail should use the unified LearnCard where the spec says so.

Verification: all 8 slugs render at /learn/templates/<slug> on the dev server (free port, do not kill dcp on 3001/3002), light and dark checked on one slug; npx eslint on changed files; yarn format:check.

Non-goals: detail routes for videos/tutorials/examples/workshops (future work, hub cards may link out or be non-clickable per spec), removing the old /templates routes (website-5yo.5 handles redirects, website-5yo.7 handles deletion).
closeReason: Detail pages landed: commits 868855df78 + fix f445e04bc4 (findRelated tier logic). All 8 slugs verified HTTP 200 at /learn/templates/<slug> on the agent's own dev server; hub re-verified after change; tsc exit 0, eslint/prettier clean. Opus review pass after 1 fix cycle.

title: Redirect /templates into /learn and update nav, sitemap, cross-links
description:
Problem: once /learn exists, /templates and /templates/[slug] would be duplicate pages, and the header nav (src/components/header/navData.tsx, entry 'Templates' with RocketIcon under Additional Resources) still points at /templates.

File scope: app/(content)/templates/ (replace pages with redirects or delete in favor of next.config redirects), next.config file if redirects go there, src/components/header/navData.tsx, app/sitemap.ts, plus any other /templates href found via grep -rn "/templates" app src --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts.

Fix direction: permanent redirects /templates -> /learn and /templates/:slug -> /learn/templates/:slug (prefer next.config redirects over stub pages). Rename the nav entry to Learn pointing at /learn (keep or swap the icon per the design spec). Ensure sitemap emits the /learn URLs and no longer emits /templates URLs.

Verification: curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} on /templates (expect 308 or 301) and /templates/agent-ready-api redirecting to the new path; nav link works in the browser; grep shows no remaining internal hrefs to /templates; npx eslint and yarn format:check on changed files.

Non-goals: deleting src/components/templates components (website-5yo.7), touching /resources.

title: Seed non-template learn content (videos, tutorials, examples, workshops)
description:
Problem: the hub must not launch as templates-only; the content-type facet needs real entries behind every type or the page contradicts its own strategy.

File scope: src/data/learn/ only (new data entries following the model from website-5yo.2).

Fix direction: add 2-3 seed entries per type for video, tutorial, example, and workshop. Source real material where it exists: ChilliCream YouTube videos, existing docs tutorials or blog walkthroughs (link into /docs or /blog), example repos on github.com/ChilliCream, and workshop material. Every entry carries the shared facet fields so filtering works. Where no real asset exists yet, prefer fewer real entries over invented ones; do not fabricate URLs.

Verification: /learn renders every content type with at least one card and each facet filter returns results (visual check on the dev server after website-5yo.3 lands; re-verify with the hub, noting cross-task interaction); npx tsc --noEmit or build type check passes.

Non-goals: detail pages for these types, redesigning the card, marketing copywriting beyond a title and tagline per entry.
closeReason: Seed content landed in commits 8823f893f5 plus follow-up URL fix commit (fullstackWorkshop externalUrl corrected to /blog/2024-04-01-fullstack-workshop, committed by orchestrator after the fixer left it in the working tree). Opus review: pass after 1 fix cycle, remaining findings minor. Gates: eslint and prettier clean on content.ts. PENDING: consolidated visual sweep of /learn (every content type shows a card, facets return results) after website-5yo.3 lands; orchestrator owns that sweep.

title: Remove blueprint-era template components and dead data exports
description:
Problem: after the hub and redirects land, the blueprint-era code is dead weight: src/components/templates/ (BlueprintBackdrop, TemplateStackArt, TemplatesHero, TemplatesClosing, TemplateCatalog, TemplateCard, TemplateDetail, productArt, stackIcons plus their .stories files) and any src/data/templates exports superseded by src/data/learn.

File scope: src/components/templates/, src/data/templates/. Delete only what grep proves unreferenced: grep -rn "components/templates\|data/templates" app src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx.

Fix direction: delete unreferenced files wholesale; where the learn components adopted a piece (for example stackIcons), move it under src/components/learn/ instead of leaving a templates-named module behind. Re-verify what website-5yo.3, .4, and .5 landed before deleting; those tasks decide what got reused.

Verification: yarn build (or npx tsc --noEmit) passes with zero references to the deleted modules; /learn and /learn/templates/agent-ready-api still render on the dev server; npx eslint and yarn format:check pass.

Non-goals: refactoring the learn components, touching anything outside the two scoped directories.

title: Content strategy and IA for /learn editorial hub (IBM Think model, Fable 5 agent)
description:
Problem: the /learn vision grew beyond a faceted catalog. User direction: /learn should work like IBM Think (https://www.ibm.com/think), an editorial hub where the blog, learning content, videos, and upcoming content (comparisons, explainers) live together. The faceted catalog stays as a browse/search surface, but the hub needs an editorial front and a content strategy. How the blog fits is explicitly undecided (IBM has no traditional blog) and must be resolved here.

Agent requirement: the orchestrator MUST run this on a Fable 5 agent (claude-fable-5). Strategy quality gate, no code changes.

Reference (observed structure of ibm.com/think, 2026-08-22): topic subnav (Artificial intelligence, Cloud, Security, News) plus Subscribe; sections in order: Latest (news grid), Featured (single big story), topic rails (Latest in artificial intelligence / AI agents / quantum computing), Feature stories, curated collections (Build your AI infrastructure, Tech trends to know), learning hubs, Top insights and explainers (what-is pages), Podcasts, Webinars, newsletter subscription.

File scope: read-only over the repo plus website/docs/design/learn-hub.md (the landed design spec from website-5yo.1). Deliverable: website/docs/design/learn-content-strategy.md.

Fix direction: inventory existing content (27 posts in content/blog with tags and RSS at /blog, the 8 templates plus the seed items from website-5yo.6, docs tutorials, YouTube videos). Define: 1) content types for the hub (article/news, comparison, explainer, tutorial, video, template, workshop, webinar) and which get detail pages vs external links; 2) a topic taxonomy fitting our world (for example Hot Chocolate, Fusion, Nitro, GraphQL fundamentals, AI/agents); 3) a route map: /learn editorial landing, where the faceted browse lives (for example /learn/browse), topic surfaces, article URLs; 4) the blog model DECISION as 2-3 concrete options with one recommendation: keep /blog as-is surfaced in rails, restyle in place, or migrate posts into the hub IBM-style with redirects and RSS preserved. Mark the blog decision as requiring a user ruling; the orchestrator must surface it to the user and record the ruling as a comment on the blog integration task before that task may start.

Verification: strategy doc exists, covers all four points, cites real repo paths, and flags the blog ruling explicitly.

Non-goals: visual design (follow-up design addendum task), any code or content changes.
closeReason: Strategy doc landed: commit 2d062f7296 plus review-note fixes committed by orchestrator (release tag mapping, redirect wording). Ran on Fable 5 per ruling. Opus review: pass, 2 minor findings, both fixed. Blog model flagged NEEDS USER RULING (recommendation: Option B, restyle /blog in place); surfaced to user, website-5yo.11 stays gated until the ruling is recorded there.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Strategy doc landed at website/docs/design/learn-content-strategy.md (commit 2d062f7296). Covers content types + detail-page policy, 5-topic taxonomy, route map (/learn editorial landing, /learn/browse catalog, /learn/articles/[slug]), and 3 blog model options. Blog model recommendation is Option B (restyle /blog in place, keep all URLs and RSS) and is flagged NEEDS USER RULING in section 5; ruling must be recorded on website-5yo.11 before it starts.

title: Design addendum: editorial hub landing, article and comparison page templates (Fable 5 agent)
description:
Problem: the landed design spec (website/docs/design/learn-hub.md from website-5yo.1) covers the faceted catalog and template details, but not the editorial hub front nor article-style pages.

Agent requirement: the orchestrator MUST run this on a Fable 5 agent (claude-fable-5). Design gate, no code changes.

File scope: read-only over src/, app/; extend website/docs/design/learn-hub.md or add website/docs/design/learn-editorial.md.

Fix direction: per the strategy doc from website-5yo.8, design: the /learn editorial landing (featured story hero, latest rail, topic rails, curated collection, explainers/comparisons section, video section, newsletter CTA), the article reading page (works for blog posts, comparisons, explainers; typography per the site scale), a comparison-page layout (structured versus content, tables), and how the faceted browse surface is entered from the landing. Must stay consistent with the existing content pages and the landed catalog design; state which existing blog components (BlogTeaser, BlogIndexShell, FromOurBlog) are reused, restyled, or replaced.

Verification: spec covers landing, article page, comparison layout, and browse entry point; names concrete components; light/dark covered.

Non-goals: implementation, changing the already-landed catalog design except where the landing requires it.
closeReason: Design addendum landed: commit e8158cb1ea (docs/design/learn-editorial.md). Ran on Fable 5 per ruling. Opus review: pass with 4 minor findings, resolutions recorded as binding comments on website-5yo.10 and .12. Covers editorial landing, ruling-neutral ArticleLayout, comparison layout, and browse entry points; prettier check passed.

comments.author: pascal
comments.text: Design spec landed as website/docs/design/learn-editorial.md (commit e8158cb1ea on pse/adds-templates). Covers: /learn editorial landing (masthead+topic subnav, featured story hero, latest, topic rails, curated catalog band, explainers list, videos, subscribe band), ruling-neutral ArticleLayout (works under blog Option A and B, no Option C assumption), comparison layout (verdict cards, FeatureComparison matrix, disclosure), and three browse entry points. Existing blog components verified and dispositioned (BlogTeaser/BlogTeaserGrid/BlogMetadata/BlogShareBar/BlogTags/SimilarPosts/TableOfContents reused as-is; BlogIndexShell/BlogSidebar untouched pending the section 5 ruling). Single-theme dark token rules stated per learn-hub.md section 7. No code changed.
